items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Joe Welsh, Eddie Dawson, Abbe Kearney, T-Boy, a little fellow named Arthur Williams, and Kearney. That kind of bad eye. I didn't see his name in that book. He was pretty good, too.

ctx.x: I never did know much about T-boy other than him being in the Eureka. You had a band with him. When was that?

Let's see now. That must have been band. Well, I'll play with T-boy and him. I'll come here. 1922. 23. At 24. T-boy. Eddie Dawson. You remember you met him? Oh yeah, I know him. I see him all the time.
You know, he's still working for the bank. Yeah, well that's...
